summary: Full backend + frontend test of new Web Push (VAPID/pywebpush) feature across admin, customer, employee. 13/13 pytest cases pass. Admin+employee notification bell UI verified end-to-end. Leave notifications (apply -> admin, reject -> employee) verified. Campaign status toggle writes broadcast with channels=['in_app'] only — ZERO rows added to email_outbox with priority='bulk' (promo emails off, as required). Dead push subscription is auto-cleaned by /push/test. SW /sw.js contains both push and notificationclick listeners.

issues: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, 9' — duplicate key `9` repeating in some list. Pre-existing, unrelated to push feature. Low priority.

action_items: Optional: locate and fix the React duplicate-key `9` warning in an admin-side list (likely a .map using a non-unique field).
critical_code_review_comments: push_service.send_push: uses asyncio.gather on asyncio.to_thread for pywebpush — good (non-blocking). Logs include push_log row (sent/devices/gone/kind) — good observability.
_fire swallows RuntimeError silently when no running loop — fine for sync callers, but any send_push task failing silently will not surface. Consider adding task.add_done_callback for logging.
VAPID_* read with os.environ[...] at import — will crash if missing. Fine for prod but makes local dev brittle; consider dict.get with a clear error raise.
announce_campaign_status now writes channels=['in_app']; email_outbox bulk send is correctly removed. Verified in DB.

/push/subscribe does light validation (endpoint + keys present) but does not validate 'keys' is a dict or that p256dh/auth are present — invalid shape will reach pywebpush later. Acceptable but could 400 earlier.
/push/test deliberately raises 400 when the user has 0 subs — matches UI copy.
